_step4_text.FLOW_TITLE: Stacks → predict → reconstruct → measure & tidy → export
_step4_text.FLOW_SUBTITLE: Run your trained model on whole stacks, then measure the cells.
_step4_text.SESSION_WORKSPACE_DESC: The project folder every step reads and writes. Shared with Steps 1–3.
_step4_text.SESSION_STACKS_DESC: Stacks you prepared in Step 1 are listed here. Ticked stacks are the ones Segment runs on.
_step4_text.STACKS_EMPTY_1: Stacks you prepared in Step 1 appear here.
_step4_text.STACKS_EMPTY_2: You have not prepared any yet — or add a folder of .tif stacks.
_step4_text.SET_SPACING_NEEDS_STACK: Set spacing needs at least one stack.
_step4_text.SET_SPACING_NEEDS_TICK: Tick a stack, or use a row’s ⋯ menu.
_step4_text.SESSION_MODEL_POINTER: The model is chosen in Segment, above its stack list.
_step4_text.ROW_WARN_CHANNELS: Channels don’t fit this model: it needs {n}, this stack has {k}.
_step4_text.ROW_WARN_NO_SPACING: No voxel size — numbers will be in voxels. Set spacing…
_step4_text.ROW_WARN_NO_SPACING_SHORT: No voxel size — runs in voxels.
_step4_text.ROW_WARN_SAME_NAME: Another stack already has this name.
_step4_text.ROW_WARN_NO_AXES: Its axis order could not be read, so it cannot run.
_step4_text.ROW_WARN_CHANGED_SINCE_PREDICT: The stack file changed since it was predicted.
_step4_text.CLEAR_PRED_CONFIRM: Delete the 2D predictions of {stack}? It goes back to unprocessed and needs Predict again.
_step4_text.SPACING_DIALOG_DESC: The voxel size, the Z direction and the axis order of {n} stacks.
_step4_text.SPACING_DIALOG_DESC_ONE: The voxel size, the Z direction and the axis order of {stack}.
_step4_text.SPACING_CHANGE_CONFIRM: Changing this makes {what} out of date for {n} stacks. They will need {action} again.
_step4_text.SPACING_SAVE_FAILED: The voxel size could not be saved. The log in Diagnostics says why.
_step4_text.RUN_ROW_AFTER_RELEASE: Named runs come after the release.
_step4_text.SEG_MODEL_DESC: The model that finds the cells.
_step4_text.SEG_MODEL_TRAINED_UNKNOWN: The channels this model was trained on are not recorded.
_step4_text.MODEL_MISSING: The active model’s files are missing. Pick it again with Change…
_step4_text.SEG_NONE_RUNNABLE: No ticked stack can run with this model.
_step4_text.VIEW_NO_RESULT: The highlighted stack has no result to show yet.
_step4_text.SEG_STACKS_DESC: Ticked stacks are the ones Predict and Reconstruct run on — the same ticks as in Session.
_step4_text.ROW_NOT_ACTIVE_MODEL: made by {model} — not the active model
_step4_text.ROW_2D_STALE: 2D made with other axes: Predict again
_step4_text.ROW_LAST_RUN_FAILED: The last {stage} failed; the earlier result is kept.
_step4_text.STACKS_RUNNING_HINT: You can still click rows and use View on finished stacks.
_step4_text.SEG_SETTINGS_DESC: Start from the settings your Step 3 run used, or from a standard set.
_step4_text.SEG_JOIN_DESC: u-Segment3D, the engine that builds the 3D cells. Each group keeps its own help lines.
_step4_text.SEG_SIZE_DESC: Cells outside this size range are dropped by the final clean-up after the 3D build, which runs only while “Skip the size limits” is unticked.
_step4_text.SEG_SIZE_OFF_NOTE: Size limits are off while this is ticked.
_step4_text.RECON_PARTIAL_CACHE: {stack}: the 2D predictions are incomplete. Predict it again first.
_step4_text.RECON_STALE_CACHE: {stack}: the 2D predictions were made with other axes. Predict it again first.
_step4_text.RECON_SOURCE_CHANGED: {stack}: the stack file changed since it was predicted. Predict it again first.
_step4_text.RECON_OVERWRITES_CONFIRM: {stack} is {status}. Reconstructing it again deletes its current cells, measurements, marks and exported 3D meshes, and starts from new cells.
_step4_text.PREDICT_OVER_3D_CONFIRM: {stack} already has 3D cells. Predicting again replaces its 2D outlines; the 3D cells stay until you Reconstruct.
_step4_text.LOG_WIDTH_IN_PIXELS: {stack}: no voxel size; cell width taken as {px} px.
_step4_text.LOG_NO_AXES: its axis order could not be read
_step4_text.LOG_PRESET_SKIPPED: [start from] {name} kept its value: the saved one would not apply
_step4_text.LOG_START_FROM_NOT_RESTORED: [start from] '{preset}' could not be restored; the settings are EpiCycle's defaults
_step4_text.PS_FLOWS_OFF_NOTE: The two fields above are used only with Smooth the flows.
_step4_text.LOG_NO_CACHE: [WARN] No prediction cache for {stack} — run Predict first.
_step4_text.MT_PREVIEW_FAILED: {stack} could not be shown. The log in Diagnostics says why.
_step4_text.STEP4_LOCK_PREDICT: Predicting — Cancel stops it after the current stack. The workspace, the ticks, the model, the settings, Measure & tidy and the other steps are locked.
_step4_text.STEP4_LOCK_RECONSTRUCT: Reconstructing — Cancel stops it after the current stack. The workspace, the ticks, the model, the settings, Measure & tidy and the other steps are locked.
_step4_text.STEP4_LOCK_MEASURE: Measuring — wait for it to finish. The stack list, the edits, Save, Finalize, Export and the other steps are locked.
_step4_text.STEP4_LOCK_SMOOTH: Smoothing {stack}. Wait for it to finish. The stack list, the edits, Save, Finalize, Export and the other steps are locked.
_step4_text.STEP4_LOCK_SAVE: Saving {stack}. Wait for it to finish. The stack list, the edits, Save, Finalize, Export and the other steps are locked.
_step4_text.STEP4_LOCK_LOAD: Loading {stack}. Wait for it to finish. The stack list, the edits, Save, Finalize, Export and the other steps are locked.
_step4_text.STEP4_LOCK_EXPORT: Exporting. Wait for it to finish. The stack list, the edits, Save, Finalize, Export and the other steps are locked.
_step4_text.WB_LOCKED: A Step 4 job is running ({job}). Marking and maps wait until it ends.
_step4_text.LOCK_WORKSPACE_REFUSED: A Step 4 job is running; the workspace was not changed.
_step4_text.STEP_EXIT_BODY:
You have unsaved changes (deletions, smoothing, marks or hand edits) that will be lost if you leave without saving.

Save changes now?
_step4_text.STEP_EXIT_SAVE_FAILED: Saving {stack} failed, so you are still in Step 4. Your edits are kept; the log in Diagnostics says why.
_step4_text.EXPORT_COLS_NOT_SHARED: • ⚠ {n} columns not shared by all stacks
_step4_text.EXPORT_COLS_RULE:
Merge uses intersection (shared columns only).
Missing values filled with NaN.
_step4_text.LOCK_ACTION_REFUSED: [lock] {action} refused: a Step 4 job is running
_step4_text.LOCK_MENU_REFUSED: A Step 4 job is running; the stack menu waits until it ends.
_step4_text.MT_STACKS_DESC: Click a stack to load it. Only reconstructed stacks are listed.
_step4_text.MT_NOT_RECONSTRUCTED: {stack} is not reconstructed yet; it appears here after Reconstruct.
_step4_text.MT_NOT_RECONSTRUCTED_MANY: {m} stacks are not reconstructed yet; they appear here after Reconstruct.
_step4_text.MT_SPACING_CHANGED: Voxel size changed since the last Measure.
_step4_text.MEASURE_DESC: Measure every cell — size, shape, brightness, neighbours — in real units.
_step4_text.REVIEW_DESC: Cells you mark good or bad in the Workbench are counted here.
_step4_text.TIDY_DESC: Round off jagged outlines. A cell too thin to survive is kept as it was.
_step4_text.FIX_DESC: Opens the 3D curator on this stack. After the release.
_step4_text.TIDY_TOPOLOGY_LABEL: Keep each cell in one piece
_step4_text.FINISH_DESC: Finalize saves this stack and marks it done, so Export takes it. It locks nothing.
_step4_text.MT_SMOOTHED: Smoothed {n} cells ({v} voxels changed, not saved). Save keeps them.
_step4_text.MT_SMOOTHED_THIN: {k} cells were too thin to smooth and were kept as they were.
_step4_text.LOG_SMOOTH_METHOD: Smoothing uses the Batch Refine method: a wider crop, one snapshot, thin cells kept. Results differ voxel for voxel from smoothing before this version.
_step4_text.MT_DELETED: Removed {n} cells ({m} left, not saved). Save keeps it.
_step4_text.MT_UNDO_AFTER_PAINT: Undo is off: cells were painted by hand after the smoothing.
_step4_text.REMOVE_CONFIRM: Remove {n} bad cells from {stack}? Undo can bring them back until you Save.
_step4_text.RESET_CONFIRM: Reset {stack} to the cells Reconstruct made? Your edits, measurements and exported 3D meshes for it are deleted.
_step4_text.REMEASURE_FINALIZED_CONFIRM: {stack} is finalized. Measuring again takes it out of Export until you Finalize it again.
_step4_text.LOAD_UNSAVED_BODY: {stack} has edits that are not saved.
_step4_text.SAVE_NO_STACK: Load a stack to save it.
_step4_text.RESET_NO_BACKUP: There is no original result to go back to for {stack}.
_step4_text.DIAG_LOG_DESC: Segmentation run events and output status.
_step4_text.MT_CHANNELS_DESC: Tick the channels whose brightness is measured; the names head the brightness columns of the table.
_step4_text.MT_RESET_DONE: Reset {stack} to the cells Reconstruct made ({n} cells).
_step4_text.SAVE_CONFIRM: Write {stack}’s cells, measurements, marks and maps to disk?
_step4_text.SAVE_TAKES_OUT_OF_EXPORT: This takes it out of Export until it is finalized again.
_step4_text.FINALIZE_CONFIRM: Save {stack} and mark it finalized, so Export takes it?
_step4_text.MESH_SAVE_FIRST: {stack} has edits that are not saved. The meshes are made from the saved cells, so it is saved first.
_step4_text.EXPORT_DESC: Workspace-wide: works on every finalized stack, whichever stack is loaded.
_step4_text.EXPORT_FINALIZED_COUNT: {k} of {n} stacks can go into Export features:
_step4_text.EXPORT_ROW_WHY_EDITED: edited after Finalize: measure and finalize it again
_step4_text.EXPORT_ROW_UNSAVED: its unsaved edits are not in the table
_step4_text.EXPORT_ROW_LEGACY: finalized before its files were recorded
_step4_text.EXPORT_ROW_UNITS_UNKNOWN: measured before units were recorded: measure and finalize it again
_step4_text.EXPORT_ROW_WHY_REFINALIZE: changed after Finalize: finalize it again
_step4_text.EXPORT_ROWS_CHANGED: The list changed; check the ticks and export again.
_step4_text.EXPORT_RUNNING: Exporting… the window’s buttons wait until it ends.
_step4_text.EXPORT_FEATURES_WHAT: One table of every active cell; removed and border cells are left out, and a column names the stack and the model.
_step4_text.EXPORT_MESH_NONE: Load a stack in Measure & tidy first.
_step4_text.EXPORT_MESH_WHAT: Saves first if there are unsaved edits, then writes one surface file per cell to {folder}.
_step4_text.EXPORT_MESH_DONE_SKIPPED: Exported {n} meshes to {stack}/ ({k} cells under 10 voxels: no mesh)
_step4_text.LOG_MESH_SKIPPED: [export] no mesh for {k} cells under 10 voxels: {ids}
_step4_text.EXPORT_BTN_LINE: Opens the export window: features from every finalized stack, 3D meshes for the loaded stack.
_step4_text.STATE_RESTORED_FROM_BACKUP: Step 4's saved state could not be read. It was kept as {file}, and Step 4 started from its last backup.
_step4_text.STATE_STARTED_EMPTY: Step 4's saved state could not be read. It was kept as {file}, and Step 4 started with no stacks.
_step4_text.STATE_RESTORED_FROM_LEGACY: Step 4's saved state could not be read. It was kept as {file}, and Step 4 started from the older state file.
_step4_text.STATE_LEGACY_UNREADABLE: The old Step 4 state file could not be read and was left as it is.
_step4_text.STATE_LEGACY_NEWER: An older EpiCycle wrote Step 4 results after this one moved to its new state file. Those results are not shown here.
_step4_text.STATE_REROOTED: [state] this workspace was copied from {old}: {n} stored paths now point into this workspace
_step4_text.STATE_MOVED_TO_ROOT: [state] step4_state.json now lives at the workspace root; the old copy was kept as artifacts/step4/{file}
_step4_text.STATE_SAVE_BLOCKED: Step 4 cannot save: its state file could not be set aside. Close other programs using it, then reopen the workspace.
_step4_text.STATE_RECONCILED: Updated {n} stacks to match the files on disk.
_step4_text.STATE_SAVE_FAILED: Step 4 could not save its state. The log in Diagnostics says why.
_step4_text.STATE_UNREADABLE_ON_ADOPT: Step 4's saved state could not be read. It will be set aside the first time you work in Step 4.
_step4_text.MT_MEASURE_FAILED: Measuring {stack} failed. The log in Diagnostics says why.
_step4_text.MT_SMOOTH_FAILED: Smoothing {stack} failed. Nothing was changed. The log in Diagnostics says why.
_step4_text.MT_LOAD_FAILED: {stack} could not be loaded. The log in Diagnostics says why.
_step4_text.MT_SAVE_FAILED: Saving {stack} failed. Nothing was overwritten. The log in Diagnostics says why.
_step4_text.MT_RESET_FAILED: Resetting {stack} failed. Nothing was changed. The log in Diagnostics says why.
_step4_text.EXPORT_FAILED: The feature export failed. The log in Diagnostics says why.
_step4_text.EXPORT_MESH_FAILED: The mesh export failed. The log in Diagnostics says why.

STEP4_HELP_LINES.run_picker_combo: The run these results belong to. This release has one run, Default; named runs, each with its own model, come later.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.new_run_btn: Named runs come after the release.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.manage_runs_btn: Named runs come after the release.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.model_change_btn: Pick the model to run — your Step 2 and Step 3 models, Cellpose’s built-in ones, or a file.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.row_tick: Ticked stacks are the ones Predict Selected and Reconstruct Selected run on; the two lists share the ticks.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.row_chip: The model that made this stack’s result; amber when it is not the model now active, so a new Reconstruct would not match it.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.row_eye: Show or hide this stack in the viewer.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.start_from_combo: Fill the settings below from your Step 3 run or from a standard set; you can still change any of them.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.chan1_combo: The channel the model reads as the cell membrane. A loaded or previewed stack shows its layer names here.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.chan2_combo: The channel the model reads as the nuclei, or none. A loaded or previewed stack shows its layer names here.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.cell_width_um_sb: About how wide one cell is, in micrometres; the model looks for cells near this size.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.normalize_cb: Stretch each slice’s brightness before the model sees it.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.rescale_cb: Used only when no cell width is set: when ticked, the image is passed to the model at its own scale; when unticked, the model resizes it by its own trained cell size. The factor used is recorded with the result.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.batch_size_sb: How many slices go to the graphics card together; lower it if the card runs out of memory.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.method_combo: The way the three views are joined into 3D cells. Only Direct is offered.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.n_cpu_sb: How many processor cores the 3D build uses.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ps_smooth_probs_cb: Blur each view's cell-probability map before the views are joined, so cells do not step from slice to slice.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ps_smooth_flows_cb: Blur each view's flows before the views are joined.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ps_sigma_perp_sb: How far the blur reaches across the slices of each view; higher removes stripes between slices.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ps_sigma_inplane_sb: How far the blur reaches within a slice; keep it low to keep detail.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ps_mask_thresh_sb: Flows where the cell probability is below this are set to zero. Used only with Smooth the flows.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ps_soft_weight_cb: Scale the smoothed flows by how likely each voxel is inside a cell. Used only with Smooth the flows.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.gd_decay_sb: How fast each step shrinks as voxels follow the flows; higher suits long, thin cells.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.gd_iters_sb: How many steps each voxel takes along the flows.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.gd_momenta_sb: How much of the previous step each step keeps (0 to 1). Rarely changed.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.gd_renorm_cb: Set the flows back to unit length at every step.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.gd_tile_z_sb: The depth of the pieces the volume is cut into for several cores. Used only with Use several cores.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.gd_tile_y_sb: The height of those pieces. Used only with Use several cores.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.gd_tile_x_sb: The width of those pieces. Used only with Use several cores.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.gd_tile_overlap_sb: How much neighbouring pieces overlap, as a fraction. Used only with Use several cores.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.do_mp_cb: Cut the volume into pieces and follow the flows on several cores at once.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ccp_ksize_sb: How many neighbouring voxels are pooled when the three views' probabilities are joined into 3D.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ccp_alpha_sb: A small count added before pooling so no single view dominates; higher evens the views out more.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ccp_smooth_sigma_sb: Blur the joined 3D cell mask before it is cut.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ccp_threshold_level_sb: Which automatic cut level decides whether a voxel is a cell; 0 is the lowest, and it must be below Number of levels minus 1.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ccp_threshold_n_levels_sb: How many bands the automatic threshold splits the probabilities into; there is one fewer level to choose from.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ccp_prob_thresh_sb: Set the cell-or-not cut by hand, from 0 to 1. Auto uses the two levels above.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ccp_min_prob_thresh_sb: The automatic cut never goes below this.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ccp_apply_one_d_p_cb: Round the automatic cut down to one decimal place.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.post_small_obj_sb: Pieces of the 3D mask with fewer voxels than this are removed.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.post_closing_sb: Close small gaps in the mask; the number is the size of the tool in voxels.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.post_dilation_sb: Grow the mask outwards by this many voxels.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.post_extra_erode_sb: Shrink the mask by this many voxels after the steps above.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ccg_ksize_sb: How many neighbouring voxels are pooled when the three views' flows are joined into 3D.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ccg_alpha_sb: A small count added before pooling so no single view dominates.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ccg_smooth_sigma_sb: Blur each view's flows before they are joined.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.ccg_post_sigma_sb: Blur the 3D flows after they are joined.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.cc_min_area_sb: Clusters of fewer voxels than this are not made into cells.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.cc_thresh_factor_sb: Where points count as crowded: the average density plus this many spreads.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.cc_smooth_sigma_sb: How much the point density is blurred before clusters are found.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.skip_postprocess_cb: When ticked (the default), the final clean-up after the 3D build does not run, so the size limits below drop nothing. Untick it to apply them.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.sf_min_size_sb: Cells with fewer voxels than this are dropped.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.sf_max_size_sb: Cells with more voxels than this are dropped.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.sf_max_size_factor_sb: With the tick below: a cell larger than the average size plus this many spreads is dropped.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.sf_do_stats_cb: Drop cells much larger than the typical cell, by the rule above.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.predict_btn: Make the 2D outlines, slice by slice in all three views, for every ticked stack; the slow part, on the graphics card.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.reconstruct_btn: Join each ticked stack’s 2D outlines into 3D cells; needs Predict first, and uses the 2D outlines already made.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.cancel_btn: Stop after the stack being worked on; finished stacks are kept.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.view_btn: Show the highlighted stack’s result in the viewer (the highlighted row, not the ticks); works while a run is going.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.mt_row_click: Load this stack to measure and tidy it; if the loaded stack has unsaved edits you are asked first.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.save_tiers_btn: Write this stack’s cells and measurements to disk; after this, Undo cannot go back further.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.finalize_btn: Finalize saves this stack and marks it done, so Export takes it. It locks nothing.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.export_btn: Opens the export window: features from every finalized stack, 3D meshes for the loaded stack.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.export_row_tick: Finalized stacks that go into Export features; a stack that cannot go says why.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.export_features_btn: Write one table of every cell from the finalized stacks, ready for your notebooks.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.export_meshes_btn: Save each cell of the loaded stack as a 3D surface file for rendering or printing.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.browse_workdir_btn: Choose the project folder. Every step reads and writes it.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.add_folder_btn: Add every .tif stack in a folder to the list.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.set_spacing_btn: Set the voxel size, the Z direction and the axis order of the ticked stacks.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.extract_features_btn: Measure every cell of the loaded stack. The Workbench opens when it is done.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.open_analysis_btn: Open the Workbench to look at the cells and mark them good or bad.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.feature_reference_btn: List every measurement and what it means.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.delete_bad_btn: Remove the cells marked bad. Undo can bring them back until you Save.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.undo_btn: Take back the last Remove or Smooth, until you Save. The maps are not brought back: compute them again.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.smooth_strength_combo: How strongly to round off the outlines.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.smooth_all_btn: Smooth every cell’s outline. A cell too thin to survive is kept as it was.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.fix_by_hand_btn: Fix cells by hand in 3D. This comes after the release.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.smooth_sigma_z_sb: How far the smoothing reaches, up and down / across.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.smooth_sigma_xy_sb: How far the smoothing reaches, up and down / across.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.smooth_preserve_topology_cb: Keep each cell in one piece: if smoothing would split a cell, it is reconnected.
STEP4_HELP_LINES.reset_original_btn: Put back the cells Reconstruct made. Your edits, measurements and exported 3D meshes are deleted.

gd_renorm_cb: Rescale the flows at each step
sf_do_stats_cb: Drop cells far from the typical size
